text:
maria_sales: Heads-up — PivotalTelco exec just asked for an immediate decision on POC continuation. Main blockers: latency spikes under burst load and unexpected egress estimates. They want a clear ops/pricing plan by EOD Fri.

ajay_se: I can repro the latency. p95 goes from ~120ms to ~420ms when concurrency >150 in eu-west. Repro script: ```ab -n 1000 -c 200 -p payload.json -T application/json https://api.redwood.io/v1/generate```

noah_engineering: Thanks Ajay. That matches our capacity model — current autoscale floor + batching causes burst queuing. We can drop p95 by 80ms with smaller batching window, but cost ~10% higher.

elias_eng_infra: Also seeing higher cross-region tail latency when requests route to us-east fallback. If we pin traffic to eu-west worker pool we avoid the extra hop. Need ops approval to override smart-routing for this customer during POC.

rachel_security: Security note — customer asked for KMS BYO and SOC2 attestation. We have SOC2 report ready (redacted). For BYO-KMS we need 2–3 days for key onboarding and HSM approval.

diane_cust_success: Customer timeline: exec wants frontend demo Mon morning. They said "if we can't hit 200qps with <200ms p95 we pause."

priya_revenue: Pricing side — their egress projection is ~120TB/mo in worst-case. Our standard hosted tier makes that very expensive. Options I can propose: 1) temporary committed throughput block with blended token price, 2) dedicated pool (reserved capacity) trial with discounted egress, 3) hybrid: keep hosted but apply egress cap + monthly true-up. Need numbers.

sam_legal: We can fast-track a one-way DPA addendum. Need cust legal contact and which data classes they consider sensitive. Can we get that today?

maria_sales: Action plan draft: Priya — draft 2 pricing options with ballpark numbers by 3pm. Elias + Noah — test pinned eu-west routing and smaller batching, report p95 and cost delta by 2pm. Rachel — share SOC2 and BYO-KMS checklist. Sam — start DPA thread. Diane — get cust legal contact & confirm Mon demo window. I'll sync with CRO after updates.

redwood-deploy-bot: [deploy] canary rollout to eu-west scheduled at 2026-03-22T13:30:00Z (id: canary-4129).

ajay_se: Quick numbers from local run (pinned eu-west + batching=20ms): p50=38ms p95=160ms p99=320ms. Cost delta estimate +12% token compute.

elias_eng_infra: Confirmed: pinned routing avoids cross-region hop. Ops can enable override for named customer for POC; I'll need a ticket in our runbook.

priya_revenue: Draft pricing (high level) — Option A: committed 250k req/mo + 20% off compute, egress tiered: first 50TB @ 0.15/GB then 0.10/GB; Option B: dedicated trial (30 days) — flat platform fee + 40% discount on egress for trial. I'll put concrete $s in doc and send to this thread by 14:45.

rachel_security: SOC2 report uploaded to share (link redacted). BYO-KMS checklist: 1) KMS ARN, 2) key policy statement, 3) rotation windows. Estimated 48–72 hours to complete onboarding with ops.

sam_legal: Got the customer legal contact from Diane. Starting DPA addendum — will aim for a redline by EOD.

diane_cust_success: Confirmed: Mon 09:00 CET works for PivotalTelco exec demo. I'll prep runbook and ask customer to restrict traffic profile to target concurrency 200 for demo.

maria_sales: Good. If all owners hit their times we'll present pricing + ops mitigations to CRO at 16:30 and then to customer at 17:30 for alignment. Anything blocking that timeline?

ajay_se: Nothing else from infra side. I'll be on the 16:30 call to answer perf questions.

priya_revenue: Sending numbers now.

redwood-deploy-bot: [status] canary-4129: success (eu-west).

elias_eng_infra: Canary confirms p95 improvement under test profile. Rolling override flag to prod for a named route for the POC window.

maria_sales: Thanks team — will update CRO and loop back. If we get the DPA redline and SOC2 link in hand by 15:00 we should be set for the exec sync. :thumbsup:

rachel_security: Uploaded attestation and operations runbook excerpt.

sam_legal: DPA redline posted — tagging @maria_sales for review.

diane_cust_success: Customer confirmed they'll limit traffic to demo profile.

maria_sales: Closing loop — CRO ok to approve temporary routing override and 30-day dedicated trial option contingent on legal signoff. We'll present the proposal to PivotalTelco at 17:30.

priya_revenue: Final note — include a clause: trial discount subject to actual egress reconciliation. I'll add that to proposal.

maria_sales: Great work. I'll follow up with a concise summary for the exec sync.
